translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Erhai Mwaaen e Maemerhoar Paiun
Iwe Jesus a sefaaeniti wutteer Jews we, eno erhai mwaaen e maemerhoar paiun ee.
Iwe nge aaemweoi aeremas ra pwan no igiwe, pwe re giutta aekkaew rhaepin minikka repwe oaturu Jesus wooan; ina faan ra pipiiy gacchiuw Jesus aere epwe aecchipwa mwaaen we wooan raaenin Sabbath we.
Iwe, Jesus a aengaeni mwaaen we e maemerhoar paiun pwe, “Itto weni mmweer aeremas kaan.”

Iwe a aeiineeor aeremas kkewe pwe, “Meeta aarh anniug e aengaenigirh sipwe mmwenen feeori noan raaenin Sabbath? Sipwe tipaengiir, aere sipwe oawoasuur? Sipwe aemenewa erhai, aere sipwe niiy noa?” Nge iir ra anniug noa rhag.

Jesus a igin soong igiwe e wegitaeg fetaen wooar, nge pwan reen oatowe rhag nge a pwan igin faayeeor, pwe igiwe e cchemaw nee tipeer nge ese pwiung reer. Iwe a aengaeni mwaaen we pwe, “Aeitiwow poawumw.” Iwe a aeitiwow paiun, iwe a mamaaw sefaaen.
Iwe Pharisees kkewe ra siusaengi wutteer Jews we nge ra noa rhu fengaen me aaemweoi rhinaen Erotes, iwe ra noa pwiungiuw wunuunun aar repwe niiy noa Jesus.
Eew Pwuwa me Oaroi Meoneoiniun we
Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra noa ppaei meoneoiniuniun Galilee, nge eew pwuwaen aeremas a ttapw noa mwiriir. Ra itto saengi Galilee me Judea,
me Jerusalem, me Idumea, me eew faniuwaen eotiwen Jordan me ikkiwe faniuwaen oaron taeninimwen Tyre me Sidon. Oanongeer aeremas kaan nge ra itto reen Jesus, pwe re rongorong meeta kkewe efeeori.
Reen aan igin towunap aeremas, iwe Jesus a aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe repwe oamoannatae efoarh pwoot faaen itan, pwe aeremas kkewe rete aepettanoa.
A aecchipwaar tae pwuwaen aeremas, nge rhooawe re semwaai ra pwan aetietiy rhag pwe repwe geotteopa.
Nge igiwe aeremas kkewe eyor aniu aenneew wooar ra weri Jesus, nge ra gaen ppiungtiw me mmwan nge ra aepwesaegini pwe, “Een Naiun Deus!”
Nge Jesus a kkepas sseor ngaeniir aniu aenneew kkewe pwe resoapw pwaeri ngaeni mwo nge erhai aere iiy iyo.
Jesus a Finiir Seig me Riiurhai Oapostonus
Iwe Jesus a faaeraeg tae wooan eew rhug nge a faingiir to mwaaen kkewe iiy e tipaeniir. Iwe ra itto reen,
nge a finiir seig me riiurhai, ikkiwe a pwan aeita ngaeniir pwe oapostonus. A aengaeniir pwe, “Iya finigaemi pwe oawpwe no reei, ipwene aefengaegaemi noa pwe oawpwe noa fenai,
nge epwe pwan yor maemaewaemi pwe oawpwe asiiur wow aniu aenneew.”
Ikkaan iir rhooawe seig me riiurhai a finiir tae: Simon, (Jesus a aeita ngaeni pwe Peter,)
James me John iwe re pwipwi, iir naiun Zebedee, (Jesus a aeita ngaeniir “Boanerges” wewen nge “Mwaaenin Pacch”),
Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James naiun Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon, iwe erhai man menat,
me Judas Iscariot, iwe e fangenoa tinnimaen Jesus.
Jesus me Beelzebul
Iwe Jesus a sefaaen noa nee iimw. Iwe pwuwaen aeremas kkewe repwan sefaaeneto, nge ra igin aetietiy aeremas iwe Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun resa taween mwongo no.
Igiwe rhooawe aeremesan ra rongorong miniwe, ra noa pwe repwe noa aemmwena, pwe aeremas ra aepesa pwe, “A pwurhunoa!”
Iwe aaemweoi sinsein anniug re itto saengi Jerusalem ra aepesa pwe, “A wartae aniuwe Beelzebul wooan. Soamwoonin aniu aenneew minne efang maemaewan pwe epwe asiiur noa aniu aenneew.”
Iwe Jesus a faingiir to reen nge a fioang ngaeniir noan fioangon awewe: “Ifa wusun Saetan epwe pwan asiuw noa Saetan?
Aere eew faniuw a ginigin fesaeng nge ra fiiow fengaen, faniuw een epwe toarop noa.
Aere eew famini e ginigin fesaeng nge regaen fiiow fengaen, famini een epwe toarop noa.
Iwe aere mweoiun Saetan a ginigin fesaeng, esoapw tongaeni ssiunaei noa, nge epwe ffeir noa aere rhiuw noa.
“Esooar erhai epwe tongaeni toonong noan imwaen erhai mwaaen mamaaw pwe epwe pwigi noa pisaegin; aere epwe mmwaen geoni noa mwo mwaaen we, ina nge epwapw mmwenen piraf me noan iimw we.
“Ennetaen, ipwe aengaenigaemi, pwe oanongaen monofitiir aeremas epwe mmwenen mwusunoa, pwan kkepas aenneew kkewe re aepesa.
Nge aere erhai e aepesa aenneewa Espritu Santus, esoapw tongaeni mwusunoa, pwe a feeori eew monofit kkewe esooar iaenin.”
(Jesus a aepesa taeppen kkepas kkeei pwe iga aaemweoi aeremas ra aepesa pwe, “Erhai aniu aenneew a no wooan.”)
Inaen Jesus me Rhooawe Pwiin
Iwe rhooawe inaen Jesus me pwiin ra wareto. Ra iu niugiun iimw we nge ra tengaeg nong pwe epwe itiwow.
Iwe rhooanap we oaron Jesus ra aengaeni pwe, “Pipiiy, inoamw me rhooawe pwiimw me rhooapwutomw ra no niugiun, nge ra mwerhaen rhuungiug.”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Iyo inaei me iyo pwiiy?”
A wegitaeg ngaeniir aeremas kkewe remooat oaron nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw wonoa, ikkaan iir inaei me pwiiy!
Pwe iyo na a feeori nee tipaen Deus, nge iiy pwiiy, me mwengeaei me inaei.”

footnotes.text: man menat: erhai mwaaen e fiiow ngaeniir sonotawaen Rome faaen itaen faniuwan.
